map.每年 3-4 月（南方）/5-6 月（梅雨季）前检查雨刷状态，确保雨季视野清晰，: Inspect wiper condition every year before March–April (southern regions) / May–June (plum rain season) for clear wet-weather vision, replacing early if needed.
map.冬季降雪结冰地区，勿强行启动冻结雨刷，以免撕裂胶条。停车立起雨刷，使用防冻玻璃水: In freezing snowy areas never force frozen wipers, or the rubber will tear. Stand the arms up when parked and use antifreeze washer fluid.
map.高温暴晒会加速橡胶老化发硬。长期停车建议遮阳，避免胶条直接暴晒于挡风玻璃上。: Heat and strong sun harden rubber faster. Use a sunshade for long parking so blades do not bake against the windshield.
map.春秋换季时清洁胶条与玻璃油膜，可延长雨刷寿命 2-3 个月。: Cleaning the blades and removing windshield oil film each spring and autumn extends wiper life by 2-3 months.
map.刮过后玻璃留有条纹状水痕，胶条已磨损或老化。: Streaky water left behind after wiping means the rubber is worn or aged.
map.雨刷在玻璃上跳动，胶条硬化或玻璃有油膜。: The blade hops across the glass because the rubber has hardened or the glass carries an oil film.
map.刮动时发出尖叫，胶条摩擦系数增大，需更换。: A squeal while wiping means higher rubber friction, so the blade needs replacing.
map.目视胶条出现裂纹、缺口、变形，应立即更换。: Any visible cracking, nicking or deformation means replace immediately.
map.出现以上任意一种信号，说明雨刷胶条已失效，建议尽快更换，以免影响雨天行车安全。: Any of the above signals means the wiper rubber has failed; replace soon so rain-driving safety is not compromised.
map.延长雨刷寿命的 6 个习惯：: Six habits that extend wiper life:
map.避免干刮：先喷玻璃水再启动雨刷，干刮会划伤玻璃并磨损胶条: Never wipe dry: spray washer fluid before starting the wipers, dry wiping scratches the glass and wears the rubber
map.定期清洁：每月用湿布擦拭胶条，去除沙尘与油污: Clean routinely: wipe the blade with a damp cloth monthly to remove grit and oil
map.去除油膜：每季度用油膜去除剂清洁挡风玻璃: Remove oil film: clean the windshield with oil-film remover each quarter
map.冬季立刷：冰雪天停车将雨刷立起，防止冻死: Stand up in winter: lift the arms in snow so they cannot freeze down
map.避免暴晒：长期停车使用遮阳挡，减缓橡胶老化: Avoid direct sun: use a sunshade for long parking to slow rubber aging
map.及时更换：即使无破损，建议 6-12 个月更换一次胶条: Replace in time: fit new blades every 6-12 months even if nothing looks broken
map.车主登记前后雨刷或胶条上次更换日期，按橡胶老化规律与使用强度推算下次更换时间，雨: Owners log when front and rear wipers or blades were last replaced and project the next date from rubber aging and usage intensity, stocking up before the rainy season.
map.出现跳刷、异响、刮拭留水痕、胶条裂纹等磨损征兆时，用周期结合目视检查判断是否该换: When chattering, squealing, streaking or cracking appears, judge by both the interval and a visual check instead of blindly waiting for the due date.
map.多车或网约车车队统一登记更换日期，按剩余寿命排序安排采购与施工，保障雨天视野安全: Fleets and ride-hailing operators log replacement dates centrally and sort by remaining life to plan purchase and fitting, keeping wet-weather vision safe.

Replace immediately on skipping, squealing, poor wiping or visible cracks; safety beats the calendar.
map.换整支雨刷还是只换胶条？: Replace the whole wiper or just the rubber?
map.若骨架无变形锈蚀、仅胶条老化，换胶条成本更低且环保；若摇臂压力不均、接头卡滞或骨: If the frame is not bent or rusted and only the rubber aged, replacing just the refill costs less and is greener; uneven arm pressure, sticky joints or a bent frame call for a complete arm replacement to keep contact. Beam wipers are usually one-piece and replaced whole.
